pattern.description: Reverse of a UI push-in: a zoomed crop of the Timeline view quickly pulls out to the full browser UI, then the cursor clicks the Delivery view in the sidebar and the table view swaps in.
pattern.why_premium: The fast pull-out re-establishes spatial context (sidebar of views) right before navigation, so the viewer sees where the click happens instead of a disorienting jump between zoomed crops.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.fromTo('.ui-frame', {scale: 1.13, xPercent: -6, yPercent: 6}, {scale: 1, xPercent: 0, yPercent: 0, duration: 0.15, ease: 'power2.inOut'}); then after ~0.4s move cursor to sidebar item, add highlight class, and hard-swap .timeline-view for .delivery-view (set autoAlpha) on the click frame.
build_hint.remotion: scale = interpolate(frame, [0, 4], [1.13, 1], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}) with matching translate; cursor path via interpolate; at click frame (~12 frames later) switch rendered view component from Timeline to Delivery with no transition.

notes: Two motions in one burst: a pull-out (camera verdict pull_out, frames 4337-4340) and a hard view swap at ~4352 after a sidebar click. Pattern chosen for the dominant pull-out; cursor_guided_demo would also fit. Pull-out may be an editor zoom in the source recording.
